file: AZ 2018 History and Social Science Standards _Update8.23.19.pdf
structure: Front matter (intro, core discipline descriptors, anchor standards table, inquiry arc, design, time table, coding explanations) then K-8 grade sections, each: title with storyline theme (e.g. 'THIRD GRADE - ARIZONA STUDIES'), narrative overview and bulleted content focus, then DISCIPLINARY SKILLS AND PROCESSES, CIVICS, ECONOMICS, GEOGRAPHY, HISTORY. Within each discipline an Anchor Standard sentence (SP1-4, C1-4, E1-5, G1-4, H1-4) precedes its grade standards coded grade.anchor.number (e.g. K.SP1.2, 6.E5.1, HS.C2.6). Extraction merges several bullets, the next anchor sentence and sub-bullets ('Key concepts include ...' examples) into one unit; these mixed units are labeled standards. High school (one 9-12 set, no courses) starts with narrative and 'Course considerations' lists (civics/government, economics, geography, US/Arizona history, world history) which are suggested topics (examples), then HS.xx standards with code and text in separate side-by-side units (x=108 code, x=180 text).
